# Loom UI — brand kit

![Loom UI](logo-mark.svg)

**Idea:** a loom weaves many threads into one fabric — Loom UI weaves small, accessible components into your app. The mark is a 3 × 3 *plain weave*: three white **warp** threads and three pale-indigo **weft** threads, over and under, on an indigo → cyan tile.

## Files (all SVG, generated by `node tools/gen-logo.mjs`)
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `icon.svg` / `logo-mark.svg` | **The app icon** (1024 × 1024, identical files): avatar, README, header. A true over/under weave with soft contact shadows and a light highlight, matching the approved PNG. |
| `favicon.svg` | Browser tab icon — same weave with thicker threads and no effects so it survives 16 px |
| `logo-mark-mono.svg` | One-color version; set `color` (e.g. `#111827`) — print, stamps, dark UI |
| `logo.svg` | Horizontal lockup for **light** backgrounds (mark + "Loom UI") |
| `logo-dark.svg` | Horizontal lockup for **dark** backgrounds |

### Raster assets (generated by `node tools/gen-icons.mjs`)
Run both generators with `npm run brand` (rasterising uses the `@resvg/resvg-js` devDependency). Output goes to `projects/playground/public/` (served by the showcase and referenced from `index.html`) and `docs/brand/exports/`.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `favicon.ico` | 16 / 32 / 48 px, legacy browsers |
| `favicon-16x16.png`, `favicon-32x32.png` | PNG favicons |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180 px full-bleed (iOS adds its own rounded mask) |
| `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png` | PWA icons (`any`) |
| `icon-maskable-512.png` | PWA maskable icon, weave inside the safe zone |
| `og-image.png` | 1200 × 630 social share card |
| `site.webmanifest` | PWA manifest (name, colors, icons) |
| `exports/` | icon 1024/512/256, square 1024, favicons, light/dark logo lockups, OG image |

Set absolute URLs for `og:image` / `twitter:image` in `index.html` at deploy time (crawlers ignore relative paths).

`icon-original-simplified.svg` is the first hand-saved vector (flat rectangles, all white threads on top). It is kept for reference only; the generated `icon.svg` replaces it because it reproduces the over/under weave and shadows of the approved design.

The wordmark text is live `<text>` (Inter 700, falling back to system fonts). Before using it in print or as a published asset, open it in Inkscape/Figma and **convert text to outlines**.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Indigo (gradient start) | `#6366F1` |
| Cyan (gradient end) | `#22D3EE` |
| Warp thread | `#FFFFFF` |
| Weft thread | `#BFD0FF` |
| Seam shadow | `#3730A3` @ 22% |
| Ink (wordmark, light bg) | `#0F172A` |
| Paper (wordmark, dark bg) | `#F8FAFC` |

## Rules
- Minimum size: 16 px (use `favicon.svg` below 32 px). Clear space: ¼ of the tile width on every side.
- Do not recolor the threads, rotate the tile, add outlines or drop shadows, or stretch the lockup.
- Don't use the mark to imply endorsement by shadcn/ui, Vercel or any other project (see `NOTICE.md`).

## Prompt for an image generator (Midjourney / DALL·E / Ideogram / Firefly / SDXL)

**Main prompt**
> App icon and logo mark for "Loom UI", an Angular component library. A rounded-square (squircle) tile with a smooth diagonal gradient from indigo #6366F1 (top-left) to cyan #22D3EE (bottom-right). Centered inside: a clean, minimal 3×3 plain-weave pattern — three vertical white threads and three horizontal pale-indigo (#BFD0FF) threads interlacing strictly over-and-under like woven fabric. Thick, rounded-end strands with tiny soft contact shadows where threads cross, perfectly symmetrical and geometric. Flat vector illustration with just a hint of depth, crisp edges, generous padding, centered composition. Modern developer-tool / SaaS brand aesthetic, similar polish to the Linear, Vercel or Raycast app icons. No text, no letters. Square 1:1, 1024×1024, isolated on a plain white background.

**Negative prompt** (SDXL / Firefly / Ideogram "avoid")
> text, letters, words, watermark, photorealistic fabric, cloth texture, 3D render, glossy plastic, busy details, thin hairlines, extra colors, noisy gradient, drop shadow outside the tile, mockup, device frame, blurry, jagged edges, cropped

**Midjourney suffix:** `--ar 1:1 --style raw --v 6 --no text, letters, watermark, mockup`

### Variants
- **Wordmark lockup:** "Horizontal logo lockup: the weave app-icon on the left, and to its right the wordmark 'Loom UI' in a bold geometric sans-serif (Inter Bold), 'Loom' in near-black #0F172A and 'UI' in muted slate at 60% opacity. Clean vector, white background, plenty of clear space."
- **Monochrome:** "Single-color version of the same woven 3×3 icon: a solid dark-navy rounded square with the weave drawn in white and thin navy gaps where threads pass over each other. Flat, high-contrast, suitable for a stamp."
- **Favicon:** "Tiny favicon-style version: very bold 3×3 weave with thick strands and minimal gaps inside a rounded square, indigo-to-cyan gradient, legible at 16×16 pixels."
- **Abstract alternatives to explore:** (a) a woven letter "L" formed by two interlacing ribbons; (b) three interlocking rounded loops (a Borromean-style knot) in the same gradient; (c) a loom shuttle passing through vertical threads, minimalist line style.

### Export checklist
1. Pick the best image, then **vectorize** (Illustrator Image Trace, Vectorizer.ai, or redraw from the generated SVGs here).
2. Master 1024×1024 PNG; derive 512, 192 (Android/PWA), 180 (Apple touch icon), 48, 32, 16 (favicon). Use `favicon.svg` for ≤ 32 px.
3. Keep a 12% safe zone for maskable (PWA) icons.
4. Convert wordmark text to outlines.
